meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the first five minutes on pleasantries. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and why did my son find out from his phone in the middle of class?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
"611"... no. 612 words at 11:52 PM on what date, Hale? Turn the screen; I read documents myself. And you still haven't said whether anyone asked Owen about it before that zero went in.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.

"Maybe." "If that makes me happy." I don't want a mark handed over to make a parent go away, Hale; I want the zero withdrawn in writing, confirmation that nothing about this is on Owen's record, and an answer on who decided it before anyone spoke to him.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you agreed to remove the zero from Owen's essay. I still require written confirmation that the zero is withdrawn, that nothing about this matter is on Owen's record, and an explanation of who decided on the zero before anyone spoke to him. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, holding Hale's offer to remove the zero and still wanting it in writing, a guarantee that nothing goes on Owen's record, and an answer on who decided before Owen was heard.
What moved her: Nothing changed her position, though the exact word count and time made her ask a real question and demand to read the document instead of just attacking.
What cost ground: Dropping the evidence straight away and offering to remove the zero to make her happy, because it looked like a mark traded to make a parent go away and left nothing for her to check.
Try next time: Right after giving the 11:52 PM version history, give its date, turn the screen so she can read it herself, and own that the zero went in before anyone called home.
